card.name: Scattered mixed words, no shared theme
card.fires_on: No single word type or setting. It fires on unrelated words such as pillars, head of the bed, parts of names and abbreviations.

modes.label: Nouns after 'the' or a number
modes.description: Plain nouns such as pillars or head appear right after a determiner or number.
modes.example: hanging on four<< pillars>>, divided the Holy Place from the Holy

modes.label: Partway through names
modes.description: Pieces of a name or abbreviation such as JPL, IP or Eicosatrienoic.
modes.example: E<<icos>>atrienoic acid was below lower limit
